routes.acquisitionSummary: Official PayGo plan: $3/mo for 100 min talk + 100 texts + 100MB 5G/4G LTE data. Overage 3¢/min, 1¢/text, 3¢/MB. Sold at ultramobile.com/paygo; T-Mobile network MVNO.

keep.action: Subscription model — $3/mo auto-renew keeps number active; no action-window reset needed. Optional: receiving SMS while roaming in China costs $0.10/SMS from wallet balance.

routes.chinaActivation: Activation requires US network or Wi-Fi Calling setup; eSIM activation from abroad unverified — pending community confirmation.
routes.kyc: No ID verification for prepaid; US card or PayPal typically required for payment.
routes.payment: US credit/debit card; international card acceptance varies (community reports mixed).
routes.wifiCalling: Supported (T-Mobile MVNO standard); enables US-number SMS over Wi-Fi abroad.
routes.roamingSms: Official rates 2026-09-26: China receive $0.10/SMS, send $0.50/SMS; voice $3.59/min; no data roaming. Roaming paid from PayGo wallet balance.
routes.tariffSummary: $3/mo = 100 min + 100 SMS + 100MB. China roaming SMS receive $0.10. Wi-Fi Calling supported. Cannot switch from PayGo to other Ultra plans (official FAQ).
guideSteps: Activate on US network (or attempt Wi-Fi Calling activation abroad — verify first).
Keep auto-renew on; number stays alive at $36/yr.
To receive verification SMS in China: enable international roaming, maintain wallet balance; each received SMS costs $0.10.

routes.acquisitionSummary: Pay As You Go credit: min top-up $20 (also $30/$40/$50). Domestic rates 1¢/min, 1¢/SMS, 2¢/MB. Credit usable for international roaming. T-Mobile network MVNO.

keep.action: Official terms (tello.com/terms): PAYG credit expires 90 days after last order and service disconnects. Cheapest durable path is the $5/month plan (unlimited texts + 100 min) = $60/yr; pure PAYG path needs a $20 top-up every 90 days = $80/yr. WiFi Calling works abroad for free SMS/calls. No KYC but billing info must be real.

routes.chinaActivation: eSIM activation generally works via app/website with Wi-Fi; Tello officially supports activation abroad via Wi-Fi Calling setup (community-confirmed route).
routes.kyc: No ID verification; email + payment method only.
routes.payment: International cards widely reported accepted; PayPal also accepted.
routes.wifiCalling: Supported and documented by Tello; primary route for using US number abroad.
routes.roamingSms: Official 2026-09-26: China roaming voice 5¢/min, SMS 1¢/SMS, data 1¢/MB, charged from PAYG balance. Wi-Fi Calling SMS bills as domestic (~1¢).
routes.tariffSummary: $20 min top-up. US: 1¢/min, 1¢/SMS. China roaming: 5¢/min, 1¢/SMS. Keep-alive ≈ send 1 SMS per 80 days.
guideSteps: Create Tello account, order eSIM, add $20 PAYG credit.
Activate eSIM (works abroad via Wi-Fi per community).
Enable Wi-Fi Calling to use the number over Wi-Fi.
Calendar reminder: send one SMS every 80 days (~1¢) to satisfy the 3-month activity policy.

routes.acquisitionSummary: Pay As You Go: $10 or $30 top-up = 90-day validity; $100 = 365-day validity. Rates 5¢ talk & text, 10¢/MB data. AT&T network MVNO.

keep.action: Balance-expiry model: recharge before expiration to keep number. $10/90d ≈ $40/yr, or $100/365d single recharge. No per-action reset documented.
